name: CERTInext AnyCA REST Gateway Plugin
description: AnyCA REST Gateway plugin for CERTInext (eMudhra) certificate lifecycle management platform

ca_plugin_config.name: ApiUrl
ca_plugin_config.description: REQUIRED: CERTInext API base URL. V1 (default): host plus /emSignHub-API/, e.g. https://us-api.certinext.io/emSignHub-API/. V2 (UseV2Api=true): bare host, e.g. https://us-api.certinext.io. Must use https.

ca_plugin_config.name: AccountNumber
ca_plugin_config.description: REQUIRED when UseV2Api is false: your CERTInext account number (numeric string). Included in the `meta` block of every V1 request. Not used when UseV2Api is true. Available in the CERTInext portal.

ca_plugin_config.name: GroupNumber
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL: CERTInext group (delegation) number. When set, it is included in product-catalog requests and in the order (`delegationInformation.groupNumber` on V1, `groupNumber` on V2) so the order is routed to the correct account group, and V2 synchronization is scoped to the group. Some accounts will queue orders for additional review when this field is omitted. Available in the CERTInext portal under Delegation → Groups.

ca_plugin_config.name: OrganizationNumber
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL: Pre-vetted CERTInext organization number. Required for OV/EV on V2; recommended for V1 OV/EV and faster DV. Skips CERTInext's manual vetting queue.

ca_plugin_config.name: TechnicalContactName
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL: Name sent as the order's technical point of contact (V1 `technicalPointOfContact.tpcName`, V2 `technicalPointOfContact.name`). Defaults to the configured RequestorName when blank. Some product configurations require a TPoC to be present; omitting it can cause CERTInext to park orders awaiting manual completion of the field.

ca_plugin_config.name: TechnicalContactEmail
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL: Email sent as the order's technical point of contact (V1 `tpcEmail`, V2 `email`). Defaults to the configured RequestorEmail when blank.

ca_plugin_config.name: TechnicalContactIsdCode
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL: International dialing code for the technical contact phone number. Defaults to the configured RequestorIsdCode when blank.

ca_plugin_config.name: TechnicalContactMobileNumber
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL: Mobile number for the technical contact (digits only). Defaults to the configured RequestorMobileNumber when blank.

ca_plugin_config.name: AuthMode
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL, legacy (V1 only): leave as 'AccessKey' (default). V1 does not honor OAuth tokens, so 'OAuth' is unsupported. Ignored when UseV2Api is true.

ca_plugin_config.name: ApiKey
ca_plugin_config.description: REQUIRED when UseV2Api is false: the REST API Access Key generated in the CERTInext portal under Integrations → APIs. Used to compute authKey = SHA256(accessKey + ts + txn); never transmitted directly. Not used when UseV2Api is true.

ca_plugin_config.name: OAuthTokenUrl
ca_plugin_config.description: Legacy / unsupported (V1): V1 does not honor OAuth tokens; leave blank. Ignored when UseV2Api is true — V2 requests its token from {ApiUrl}/oauth/token.

ca_plugin_config.name: OAuthClientId
ca_plugin_config.description: OAuth client ID. REQUIRED when UseV2Api is true: V2 authenticates with client_credentials against {ApiUrl}/oauth/token. The key must be generated in OAuth mode in the CERTInext portal. Not used on V1.

ca_plugin_config.name: OAuthClientSecret
ca_plugin_config.description: OAuth client secret. REQUIRED when UseV2Api is true (see OAuthClientId). Not used on V1.

ca_plugin_config.name: RequestorName
ca_plugin_config.description: REQUIRED: Default requestor name submitted with all certificate orders. This is the name of the person/service responsible for the certificates.

ca_plugin_config.name: RequestorEmail
ca_plugin_config.description: REQUIRED: Default requestor email submitted with all certificate orders. Must be a valid email address registered in your CERTInext account.

ca_plugin_config.name: RequestorIsdCode
ca_plugin_config.description: International dialing code for the requestor phone number (e.g. '1' for US). Default: '1'.

ca_plugin_config.name: RequestorMobileNumber
ca_plugin_config.description: Requestor mobile number (digits only, no country code).

ca_plugin_config.name: RequestorDesignation
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL: Job title / role of the requestor (e.g. 'IT Administrator'). Sent as requestorInformation.requestorDesignation (V1) and requestor.designation (V2). Free text. Omitted when blank.

ca_plugin_config.name: SignerPlace
ca_plugin_config.description: City or location of the subscriber agreement signer (e.g. 'San Francisco, CA'). REQUIRED when UseV2Api is on: the V2 Subscriber Agreement sent with every SSL order requires it, so the connector cannot be saved with it blank. A per-template SignerPlace enrollment parameter overrides it.

ca_plugin_config.name: SignerIp
ca_plugin_config.description: IP address of the subscriber agreement signer. V1 sends 127.0.0.1 with a warning when blank; V2 omits it. A template-level SignerIp enrollment parameter overrides it on V2.

ca_plugin_config.name: DefaultProductCode
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL: Default numeric product code. V1: used for renewals when the template supplies none. V2: disambiguates a ProductId-only template when the catalog has several matches. Get codes via GetProductDetails.

ca_plugin_config.name: AccountingModel
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL: CERTInext billing model sent in `orderDetails.accountingModel` on V1 orders. "2" = credit-based (most accounts, default). "1" = cash model. Not used by V2.

ca_plugin_config.name: EmailNotifications
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL: Lifecycle emails to the requestor. "1" = full set (V2: "all"), "0" = silent. Blank: silent on V1, omitted on V2 (CA default applies). Other values fail V2 enrollment. Default: "0".

ca_plugin_config.name: SubscriptionValidityYears
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL: Default validity in years for SSL orders. "1", "2", or "3". Override per template via the ValidityYears product parameter. Default: "1".

ca_plugin_config.name: SubscriptionAutoRenew
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL: Whether CERTInext should auto-renew certificates issued through this connector. "0" = disabled (recommended — renewal is driven by Keyfactor Command), "1" = enabled. Default: "0".

ca_plugin_config.name: SubscriptionRenewCriteriaDays
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL: Days before expiry at which CERTInext auto-renews (only honored when SubscriptionAutoRenew = "1"). Typical values: "30" or "60". Default: "30".

ca_plugin_config.name: AutoSecureWww
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL: If "1", CERTInext automatically adds the `www.` variant of the primary domain as an additional SAN. "0" = use only the CN/SANs supplied with the CSR. Default: "0".

ca_plugin_config.name: IgnoreExpired
ca_plugin_config.description: If true, expired certificates are skipped during synchronization. V2 only: the V1 sync does not currently apply it. Default: false.

ca_plugin_config.name: SubmitNonDnsSans
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL (V1 only): If true (default), non-DNS SANs (IP, email, URI) are submitted, but CERTInext cannot validate them, so the order won't issue. If false, only DNS names are submitted.

ca_plugin_config.name: PageSize
ca_plugin_config.description: Number of orders to fetch per page during synchronization (1 or higher). Default: 100, max: 500 (V2 `/reports/orders` pages are capped at 100).

ca_plugin_config.name: Enabled
ca_plugin_config.description: Enables or disables the CA connector. Set to false to create the connector record before credentials are available. Default: true.

ca_plugin_config.name: LogSensitiveRequestData
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL temporary diagnostic switch. When true, requestor personal data (name, email, phone) and full CA payloads are logged. Credentials are always redacted. Turn off after verifying. Default: false.

ca_plugin_config.name: PickupRetries
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL: Times Enroll() polls CERTInext for the certificate after order submission (0-30; 0 disables the wait). Unissued orders are picked up by sync. Default: 5.

ca_plugin_config.name: PickupDelay
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL: Seconds between certificate-pickup polls (1-60). Total wait is 5 s + PickupRetries x this value, capped at 180 s. Default: 10 (~55 s with default retries).

ca_plugin_config.name: DcvEnabled
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL: When true, the plugin performs DNS-based Domain Control Validation (DCV) during enrollment and synchronization for orders that require it, using the DNS provider plugin deployed on the gateway (e.g. azure-azuredns-dnsplugin). Without a DNS provider plugin, orders that need validation stay pending and the plugin logs why. Set to false to skip DCV. Default: true.

ca_plugin_config.name: DcvTxtRecordTemplate
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL: Format string for the DNS TXT record hostname used during DCV. {0} is replaced with the domain name being validated. Default: _emsign-validation.{0}

ca_plugin_config.name: DcvPropagationDelaySeconds
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL: Seconds to wait after publishing the DNS TXT record before asking CERTInext to verify it. Increase for zones with slow propagation. Default: 30.

ca_plugin_config.name: DcvTimeoutMinutes
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL: Maximum minutes for the entire DCV flow (DNS publish + propagation + verify) for one order before it is abandoned and left pending. Can also be set via the CERTINEXT_DCV_TIMEOUT_MINUTES environment variable; the env var takes precedence when both are set. Default: 10.

ca_plugin_config.name: DcvWaitForChallengeSeconds
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL (V1 only): Seconds Enroll() waits for CERTInext to expose the DCV challenge. 0 disables the wait. CERTINEXT_DCV_WAIT_FOR_CHALLENGE_SECONDS overrides it. Default: 60.

ca_plugin_config.name: DcvWaitForIssuanceSeconds
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL (V1 only): Seconds Enroll() waits for issuance after DCV verifies. 0 disables the wait. CERTINEXT_DCV_WAIT_FOR_ISSUANCE_SECONDS overrides it. Default: 60.

ca_plugin_config.name: DcvSyncMaxOrderAgeHours
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL: During synchronization, only pending DV orders younger than this many hours are driven through DCV. 0 disables the filter. Default: 24.

ca_plugin_config.name: DcvSyncMaxPerPass
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL: Maximum pending DV orders driven through DCV per synchronization pass. 0 disables the cap. Default: 50.

ca_plugin_config.name: UseV2Api
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL: When true, the plugin routes Ping / Enroll / GetSingleRecord / Revoke / Synchronize through the CERTInext V2 REST API (/api/certinext/v2/), including V2 /reports/orders for Synchronize. Requires ApiUrl (the V2 base URL in this mode), OAuthClientId, OAuthClientSecret, and SignerPlace. V1 credentials (ApiKey/AccountNumber/AuthMode) are not required when this is true. Default: false (V1 API).

ca_plugin_config.name: V2SyncLookbackHours
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL (V2 only): Hours subtracted from the last-sync time on incremental sync, so an order created earlier but issued later is not missed. Default: 72.

ca_plugin_config.name: SyncRecentOrderGraceSeconds
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL: during a Synchronize (full or incremental, in both V1 and V2 modes), a pending or issued order created less than this many seconds ago (plus a small clock margin) is not emitted to the gateway (an issued one is not downloaded); the next incremental pass imports it. This stops the sync from inserting a gateway row for an order whose enrollment is still in flight, which would make the enrollment's own save fail with a duplicate key. Revoked and failed orders are never held back. 0 disables the hold; a negative value uses the default. Default: 120.

ca_plugin_config.name: V2InlineCsr
ca_plugin_config.description: OPTIONAL (V2 mode only): when true, SSL/TLS enrollment sends the CSR inline in the order create call (a single POST /ssl-certificates) instead of the default two-call flow (create the order, then PUT .../csr). This matches a direct single-call API integration and is about 4-5 seconds faster, but the create call then often holds about 20 seconds until the certificate is issued, and a create that times out or returns a 5xx can leave an order that still issues; it is not cancelled and the next synchronization imports it, so do not resubmit. Private PKI orders ignore this setting and always use the two-call flow (the CA rejects an inline CSR on Private PKI create). Ignored when UseV2Api is false. Default: false (two-call).

enrollment_config.name: ProductCode
enrollment_config.description: OPTIONAL: Override the numeric CERTInext product code for this template. When omitted: on V1, the default production code for the selected product is used (e.g. DV SSL → 838); on V2, the code is resolved from the live CERTInext product catalog by matching the selected product, so it stays correct even though V2 catalog numbering varies by account. Required for ProductFamily 'private-pki'. Set this explicitly when targeting sandbox or a non-standard code.

enrollment_config.name: ProfileId
enrollment_config.description: DEPRECATED: Use ProductCode instead. Kept for backward compatibility — mapped to ProductCode if ProductCode is not set.

enrollment_config.name: ValidityYears
enrollment_config.description: OPTIONAL: Subscription validity in years: 1, 2, or 3. Default: 1. Note: CERTInext validates per 390-day certificate within the subscription; the 'validity' field in the order is the subscription term, not certificate lifetime.

enrollment_config.name: ValidityDays
enrollment_config.description: DEPRECATED: Use ValidityYears instead. V1 only: if set, value is divided by 365 and rounded up to get the subscription year count.

enrollment_config.name: AutoApprove
enrollment_config.description: Currently has no effect — reserved for future use. The plugin does not call any approval endpoint against CERTInext regardless of this setting. Default: false.

enrollment_config.name: RequesterName
enrollment_config.description: OPTIONAL: Overrides the connector RequestorName for this template when non-blank. Never derived from the certificate subject.

enrollment_config.name: RequesterEmail
enrollment_config.description: OPTIONAL: Overrides the connector RequestorEmail for this template when non-blank. Never derived from the certificate subject.

enrollment_config.name: RenewalWindowDays
enrollment_config.description: OPTIONAL: V1 only. Number of days before certificate expiration within which a renewal is triggered. Certificates expiring further than this window are reissued instead. Certificates that have already expired also fall back to reissue. V2 places a new order for every renewal and reissue. Default: 90.

enrollment_config.name: KeyType
enrollment_config.description: OPTIONAL: Informational. The key algorithm is determined by the submitted CSR; CERTInext accepts RSA 2048/3072/4096 and ECC P-256/P-384 and rejects larger RSA, ECC P-521, and Ed25519/Ed448.

enrollment_config.name: DomainName
enrollment_config.description: OPTIONAL: Primary domain for SSL/TLS orders (for V2 private-pki orders, the primary hostname). Derived from the CSR CN if omitted.

enrollment_config.name: SignerName
enrollment_config.description: OPTIONAL: V2 only. Per-template subscriber agreement signer name. Falls back to the requestor name if omitted. V1 uses the connector-level RequestorName.

enrollment_config.name: SignerPlace
enrollment_config.description: OPTIONAL: V2 only. Per-template signer city/location. Falls back to the connector-level SignerPlace if omitted. V1 uses the connector-level SignerPlace.

enrollment_config.name: SignerIp
enrollment_config.description: OPTIONAL: V2 only. Per-template signer IP address. Falls back to the connector-level SignerIp if omitted. V1 uses the connector-level SignerIp.

enrollment_config.name: ProductFamily
enrollment_config.description: V2 ONLY: Product family for this template. Accepted values: 'ssl' (default) or 'private-pki'. 'private-pki' requires an explicit ProductCode and a Private PKI ProductVariant. 'signature' (Document Signer) is accepted by the parameter, but Document Signer enrollment is not supported.

enrollment_config.name: ProductVariant
enrollment_config.description: V2 ONLY: Product variant sent in the V2 order body. ProductFamily 'ssl': 'dv', 'ov', or 'ev' — if omitted, derived from the selected product; an explicit value that contradicts the product fails enrollment. ProductFamily 'private-pki': 'intranet-ssl' or 'igtf-host' (required; no default).
